record.body:
## Rationale

The user chose this. Questions and many findings belong to the effort rather than one phase, so the journal is reached from the main screen; the phase scope and a toggle match the decision log.

## Counter-argument

As a phase-screen tab the journal would sit next to the Spec and Evidence it explains, under one back stack.

payload.alternatives: a Journal tab on the phase screen; both a phase-screen tab and an effort-wide screen
payload.choice: A Journal screen opened with J from the main screen, scoped to the selected phase, with a toggling the whole effort

record.subject: journal-screen
